updates.title: Automatic Updates (Tauri 2 Native Updater)
updates.upToDateMsg: You are running the latest version of Stardew Sync (v{version}).
updates.gameRunningNoticeText: Stardew Valley is currently running. Application updates modify Stardew Sync files only and will not touch your saves or game data. (Game-running safety restrictions apply strictly to save writes, host migrations, and Xbox WGS sync).
updates.saveOpNoticeText: A save operation (backup, restore, or migration) is currently running. Application updates are temporarily paused to ensure active operations are not interrupted.
updates.compatNoticeText1: Upgrading from Installed v0.1.0 to v0.1.1: The initial development build (v0.1.0) trusted an unencrypted development key and a preliminary repository URL. Because that preliminary endpoint does not host releases, in-app updating from v0.1.0 to v0.1.1 was intentionally disabled.
updates.compatNoticeText2: To upgrade to v0.1.1, run the signed Windows NSIS setup package (Stardew Sync_0.1.1_x64-setup.exe) manually once. Your settings and saves will remain completely intact.
updates.compatNoticeText3: Subsequent Updates (v0.1.1+): Future updates are retrieved, cryptographically verified with password-protected Minisign keys, and installed automatically in-app via GitHub Releases.
updates.securityPolicy1: Signed Artifacts Only: Unsigned binaries are strictly rejected by the Tauri 2 core updater engine.
updates.securityPolicy2: Secret Key Security: The private signing key is stored outside the repository with restricted user ACLs and protected by a strong passphrase.
updates.securityPolicy3: Save & Game Isolation: Application updates modify Stardew Sync binaries only and never touch Stardew Valley save files or Xbox WGS storage. Game-running safety restrictions apply to save writes and migrations, allowing application updates to proceed safely at any time.
updates.securityPolicy4: Operation Guard: Updates are paused only during active in-flight save transfers or migrations to avoid interrupting background operations.
